content: There are several approaches we could take to perform CEI starting from unannotated data. We could simply run CEI prediction by itself (CEI Only) or the pipeline of CP first and then only run CEI on documents predicted as causal (CP + CEI). Further, the CEI model could be trained only on those documents annotated causal (as was done in the previous experiments) or on all training documents including many that are not causal.
